summary: Verified end-to-end the new Header/Cover photo feature on web (frontend + backend round-trip re-confirmed). Backend: PUT /api/auth/me persists cover_url and empty string clears it; GET /api/auth/me and GET /api/users/@semidiepie both return it. Settings → Profile card renders the Header photo section with settings-cover-preview (shows the image via inline background-image + background-size:cover when set, branded gradient when empty), settings-upload-cover (label toggles 'Change' ↔ 'Add photo'), and settings-remove-cover (present only when a cover is set). Profile page data-testid=profile-cover shows the cover image filling the entire banner (background-size: cover, 766×176px) and the circular avatar overlaps 64px into the banner with avatar painting on top (elementFromPoint at the overlap zone returns the avatar IMG, not the banner div — avatarWrap relative z-10 holds). Removing cover in Settings + Save profile reverts the Profile banner to the branded orange→secondary→background gradient placeholder (no broken image). Both Dark and Light themes render cover + avatar correctly. No regression on Settings Profile form fields or Profile header (name, @handle, OFFICIAL badge, bio, inline counts, action pills, Posts/Reels/Videos/Blogs tabs). FEATURE = PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx:188-202 uploadCover reuses the exact same proven Cloudinary pipeline as uploadAvatar (uploadToCloudinary + state patch + 'save to apply' toast) — DRY-consistent with the avatar flow and no additional review concerns.

server.py:952 update_me filters out None (not empty string), so PUT {"cover_url":""} correctly reaches $set and clears the field — intended behavior matches the review spec ('empty string clears it'). Verified end-to-end.

Profile.jsx:138-150: cover div uses conditional inline style (bg-image when cover_url is truthy, gradient Tailwind classes otherwise) + an extra radial-highlight child only in the gradient path. Clean, minimal and avoids a broken-image state when cover is empty.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testIDs present, both themes, remove+save flow, non-regression on profile header + settings form)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cover photo feature verified. Measured values: profile-cover 766×176px with bgSize:cover; avatarTop=137, coverBottom=201 (64px overlap); elementFromPoint at overlap zone returns avatar IMG, confirming z-10 stacking still works with the new background-image on the banner. For future tests of this feature use page.request.put /api/auth/me with {cover_url:'...'} to set, {cover_url:''} to clear — avatar flow is identical. Note that update_me filters None but keeps empty strings, so UI patterns that use undefined vs '' must be careful.
